title: Cloud SQL: Precheck Options, Database Center & Workload Capture Updates
summary: Cloud SQL introduces new controls for major version upgrades and Database Center integration. The `WorkloadCapture` schema also sees updates, including a new `TERMINATED` state and a breaking change where `backupId` is now read-only.
details:
Developers, take note: The `backupId` property within the `WorkloadCapture` schema is now explicitly `readOnly`. If your code was previously attempting to set this value, it will now result in an error. 

On the `DatabaseInstance` front, you can now manage `databaseCenterIntegration` (enabled by default) and utilize new options for major version upgrades. A `skipPrecheck` boolean field allows bypassing the precheck step, and `PreCheckMajorVersionUpgradeContext` gains a `maxRuntime` field to set duration limits for precheck operations. 

Finally, the `WorkloadCapture` schema's `workloadCaptureState` enum now includes a `TERMINATED` state for automatically stopped captures, and the `COMPLETED` state description has been clarified for user-initiated stops.
